options.name: access_logging
options.description: Access logging provides records for the requests that are made to a bucket.

options.name: auth
options.description: Parameters for authenticating with the AWS service. Each of them may be defined via environment variables.

options.name: clear_tags
options.description: Whether to clear any existing tags on the resource that are not explicitly stated in I(tags). By default, existing tags are kept on the resource. When this parameter is set to C(true), any pre-existing tags on the resource are removed.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of S3 bucket. Not every string is an acceptable bucket name. The name must be unique across all existing bucket names in Amazon S3. For naming restrictions see U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/dev/BucketRestrictions.html)

options.name: public_access
options.description: Ensure that public access to your S3 buckets and objects is blocked.

options.name: state
options.description: Target state of the Bucket. If absent, it will delete bucket even if it is not empty.

options.name: tags
options.description: Metadata for the AWS resource as key/value pairs. Keys and values are case-sensitive.

options.name: versioning
options.description: Enables you to keep multiple versions of an object in the same bucket.
